details: The U.S. national debt is rapidly approaching $40 trillion, reaching this milestone faster than any previous trillion-dollar increase in the country's history. This rapid accumulation of debt is cited by the crypto industry as a strong argument for Bitcoin as a hedge against currency debasement. Senator Cynthia Lummis's proposed BITCOIN Act, targeting 1 million BTC, is suggested to potentially cut the national debt by up to 50%.
title: US Debt Nears $40 Trillion, Strengthening Bitcoin's Case

details: Recent SEC filings indicate that major Wall Street firms, including Jane Street Group, Bank of America, and Morgan Stanley, have been quietly increasing their positions in Ripple (XRP) exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Jane Street Group held over 1.2 million shares of the Bitwise XRP ETF alone, demonstrating continued institutional interest despite the broader market landscape.
title: Wall Street Firms Accumulating Ripple (XRP) ETFs

details: Ether.fi's native token, ETHFI, experienced an 8% price jump following its "Summer" platform upgrade. This upgrade introduces revenue-funded ETHFI buybacks, strengthening the link between platform activity and token value. The development also triggered a technical breakout above key resistance levels and the 200-day exponential moving average, attracting momentum traders.
title: Ether.fi's "Summer" Upgrade Drives ETHFI Token Surge

details: Zcash (ZEC) saw a 5.29% surge driven by recent positive ecosystem developments, including the establishment of Zcash Labs. Zcash Labs is focused on business and institutional adoption, with its first major project, "zcashtocash," aiming to integrate ZEC with major fintech applications across over 100 geographies. This fundamental growth is amplified by a technical bounce from critical support levels.
title: Zcash (ZEC) Surges 5.29% Amid Ecosystem Developments

details: After a strong start to August, Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) experienced net outflows of nearly $390 million last week, breaking a streak of significant inflows. Ethereum ETFs also saw net withdrawals, albeit less severe, snapping a five-week positive streak. This indicates a shift in investor sentiment for both major cryptocurrency ETFs.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF Flows Turn Negative Last Week

details: David Tait, CEO of the World Gold Council, reiterated his personal opinion that Bitcoin is destined to go to zero. He argued that Bitcoin consistently behaves as a high-beta risk asset during market downturns rather than serving as a reliable hedge. This viewpoint resurfaced and gained traction following market stresses, highlighting ongoing skepticism from some traditional finance figures.
title: World Gold Council CEO Predicts Bitcoin Will Go to Zero
